_comment: Demo_Game activity definitions — loaded at runtime by DemoQuestManager::TryLoadFromJSON. These override the C++ defaults in demo_quest_manager.cpp when ENGINE_ENABLE_JSON is active. See docs/DEMO_GAME.md for gameplay details.

mainQuest.title: Tour of the Engine
mainQuest.description: Explore the Demo_Game open world and visit three key teaching stations to complete your orientation tour. Use the F1 overlay to teleport between stations.

objectives.description: Return to the PBR Rendering station to complete the tour

activities.title: Station Scanner
activities.description: Visit 3 different teaching stations in the open world. Open the F1 menu, browse the station list, and press Enter to teleport.

activities.title: Combat Challenge
activities.description: Defeat 5 enemies near the Action Combat station. Use the combo attack system (press F1 and teleport to the 'Action Combat' station first).

activities.title: Collector's Run
activities.description: Collect 5 Engine Crystals scattered at teaching stations across the open world.
